The '''Athallia sector''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Athallia sector bordered the [[Mikaster sector/Legends|Mikaster sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] and the [[Baroli sector/Legends|Baroli sector]] [[spinward]], while sharing the [[trailing]] border with the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]]. Together with the Baroli and Boeus sectors, the Athallia sector formed the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border, neighboring the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

The Athallia sector contained the [[Athallia system/Legends|Athallia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which in turn was the site of the astronomical object [[Athallia]]. The latter was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] [[Fin Mak'lath]], who left Athallia for<ref name="RoguesGallery">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}} states [[Fin Mak'lath]] left [[Athallia]] and moved to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where he eventually became a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]]. "Rogues Gallery" also depicts Mak'lath serving in the ranks of the Wing Guard during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, Mak'lath must have departed Athallia at some point by 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Athallia sector was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the StarWars.com [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region] provided the first visual depiction of the Athallia sector and placed it in grid squares M-14, M-15, N-14, and N-15.<ref name="Expansion" />
